Priya Patel: Quick sync — Acme pilot requires ~50k tokens/sec sustained with p95 < 450ms. Can runtime/infra commit to a canary by EOM?
Marcus Chen: Need more detail on sequence lengths + prompt shapes. Rough estimate: 2x A100-equivalent for baseline, 4x with redundancy/peak. Batching profile could shave cost. Can we relax p95 to 500ms for canary? :thinking_face:
Elena Rodriguez: Infra caveats: autoscaler adjustments, quota bump, and extra NAT/egress capacity. Kernel/runtime patching window also needed. Lead time for infra work ~3 weeks unless we fast-track.
Samir Gupta: Security ask: full dataflow (what Acme will send), retention rules, and whether any PII could be in prompts. We need a short threat model + SOC2 addendum signoff — estimates +2 weeks unless docs already exist.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Suggested maintenance window for infra changes: `2026-04-12T22:00Z` -> `2026-04-13T02:00Z`.
Priya Patel: Proposal: 10% traffic canary, 2-hour window, auto-rollback on error rate >1% OR p95 > 600ms. Feature-flagged rollout + model-variant fallback to cheaper quantized model. :white_check_mark:
Marcus Chen: 10%/2hr ok. I'll add a prefix cache warmup step and a KV cache prefetch job. Plan: feature flag + `model-fallback` path. Need infra readiness by 2026-04-04 to hit canary timeline.
Elena Rodriguez: I'll target 2026-04-03 for infra changes (autoscaler rules + quota ticket). Filing cloud quota ticket now — link: https://provider.example/quotas/12345 :link:
Samir Gupta: If Priya can share Acme dataflow doc by EOD tomorrow I can triage risk and shorten review. Otherwise schedule +2 weeks.
Priya Patel: Sharing dataflow and retention spec by EOD. Also note Acme considers this high priority — they'd like mid-April pilot.
Marcus Chen: One more runtime note: we should avoid large-model quantization during canary. Use model-variant fallback only after canary stabilizes. Also will provide perf runbook and a short smoke test script.
Priya Patel: Action items (owners & due dates):
- Priya Patel: deliver Acme dataflow + retention doc (due: 2026-03-22)
- Marcus Chen: perf runbook + cache warmup script (due: 2026-03-25)
- Elena Rodriguez: infra autoscaler changes + quota ticket (due: 2026-04-03)
- Samir Gupta: security triage & checklist (due: 2026-03-29)
- All: readiness check call 2026-04-04 15:00 PT (invite pending)

Priya Patel: Quick config for the canary (will put in runtime config repo):
```
canary:
  traffic_percent: 10
  duration: 2h
  rollback_conditions:
    - error_rate > 1%
    - p95_response_time_ms > 600
  fallback: model-variant-quantized (only after stabilization)
```

Marcus Chen: I'll open the runtime PR and tag infra/security. Will include a smoke test that hits prefix cache warmup and KV prefetch.
Elena Rodriguez: Once quota ticket is approved I'll post the provider approval here.
Samir Gupta: Noted — will prioritize review once doc is in.
Priya Patel: Thanks team — goal is to keep scope minimal for canary: no new quantization, feature flag only, clear rollback. Will escalate if any blocker. :rocket:
Marcus Chen: :thumbsup:
Elena Rodriguez: :thumbsup:
Samir Gupta: :eyes:
